title: AStockArena: Beyond Returns, Can We Entrust Real Capital to the Decisions of Financial Agents?
abstract: arXiv:2611.00515v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in dynamic financial trading, yet real-time trading benchmarks mainly evaluate agents by cumulative returns and risk-adjusted performance. Such outcome metrics cannot show whether trades are faithfully reported, supported by available evidence, and consistent with account states. We introduce AStockArena, a real-time decision-auditing benchmark for continuous trading in China's A-share market. Under shared market conditions and execution constraints, we evaluate 13 open- and closed-source models over 3,198 sequential decisions. AStockArena reconstructsthe actions actually posted to accounts by aligning reports, trade requests, execution responses, and account states, and audits them with eight checks spanning execution traceability (O), evidence sufficiency (RK), and financial meta-awareness (B), combining record verification with consensus expert annotation. Of 1,070 trading points, 72.

translated_title: AStockArena：超越收益，我们能否将真实资本托付给金融智能体的决策？
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地被应用于动态金融交易，然而现有的实时交易基准主要依据累计收益和风险调整后的表现来评估智能体。这类结果指标无法反映交易是否被如实报告、是否有可用证据支撑、以及是否与账户状态保持一致。我们提出了AStockArena，一个面向中国A股市场连续交易的实时决策审计基准。在共享的市场条件和执行约束下，我们评估了13个开源与闭源模型在3,198个连续决策上的表现。AStockArena通过将报告、交易请求、执行响应与账户状态进行对齐，重构了实际提交到账户的操作，并通过八项检查对其进行审计，这些检查涵盖执行可追溯性（O）、证据充分性（RK）和金融元认知（B），同时结合了记录验证与共识专家标注。在1,070个交易点中，72……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出AStockArena——一个针对中国A股市场连续交易的实时决策审计基准，通过涵盖执行可追溯性、证据充分性和金融元认知的八项检查来审计13个模型在3,198个连续决策中的真实行为，超越单纯收益指标以回答金融智能体是否值得托付真实资本的问题。
